defs.def: to remove sth from the ground with a tool 掘得；（采）掘出
to search in sth in order to find an object in sth 寻找，搜寻（物品）

to search thoroughly for information 探究；搜集；细查
to try hard to provide the money, equipment, etc. that is needed 尽力提供（所需金钱、设备等）
